approved.en: Melania Trump hosted Russian and Ukrainian negotiators at the White House, urging a lasting truce while fighting continued across multiple fronts. Russian drones struck an Ozon warehouse in southern Russia and a Ukrainian aid centre, causing dozens of deaths, and Ukraine launched drone attacks on the Ryazan refinery and on sites in Dnipropetrovsk and Kyiv oblasts, injuring four people. Germany announced an additional €100 million for Ukrainian infrastructure and Italy prepared fresh military aid despite coalition splits. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Melania Trump var vert for russiske og ukrainske forhandlere i Det hvite hus, og oppfordret til en varig våpenhvile mens kampene fortsatte på flere fronter. Russiske droner rammet et Ozon-lager i sørlige Russland og et ukrainsk hjelpesenter, noe som førte til flere titalls dødsfall, og Ukraina gjennomførte droneangrep mot Ryazan-raffineriet og på mål i Dnipropetrovsk og Kyiv-oblaster, hvor fire personer ble skadet. Tyskland kunngjorde ytterligere 100 millioner euro til ukrainsk infrastruktur, og Italia forberedte ny militærhjelp til tross for splittelser i koalisjonen. Dødsfall knyttet til kamper beløp seg til 75 767 i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli settlers seized eight Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens, while Israeli forces demolished homes in Biddu, displacing over 100 Palestinians and rebuilding a West Bank outpost on a Palestinian family's land. Palestinians in Gaza are improvising infrastructure, building wind turbines from rubble and turning discarded cooking pots into seawalls, as gunfire damaged tents at the Rafah displacement site. Tony Blair met Netanyahu and Herzog to advance a Gaza plan, and Ra’am chief Abbas declined to label Hamas a terror group, citing family safety concerns. The Joint List announced it will back Eisenkot to form Israel's next government. 21,440 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Hezbollah responded with artillery fire on Israeli positions and began distributing its first cash payments to war victims and displaced families. The United Nations reported 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon due to the fighting. Israel also built a new road in the Shebaa Valley buffer zone, a development not mentioned in the previous briefing.

FN rapporterte at 300 000 personer er fordrevet i Libanon på grunn av kampene. Israel bygde også en ny vei i bufferområdet Shebaa-dalen, en utvikling som ikke ble nevnt i forrige briefing.

South Korea is moving naval and anti-piracy operations closer to the strait to keep it open, and Iran reports tankers hit in Hormuz and a Saudi coalition intercepting a missile toward Medina. Iran har sendt et atomforslag til USA via Qatar og gjennomgår konkrete forslag til sitt atomprogram. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi forces maintain a month-long siege of Taiz while Yemeni government troops have captured the strategic al-Jawf mountain range. The government accuses Iran’s IRGC and Hezbollah of sending 21 experts to support the Houthis, indicating heightened external involvement. Saudi airstrikes in Yemen killed seven people and the Saudi coalition reported downing a ballistic missile as the Houthis demanded $51 billion for a ceasefire, while Saudi forces also intercepted Houthi missiles aimed at Medina. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Saudi-luftangrep i Jemen drepte syv personer, og den saudiske koalisjonen rapporterte at de hadde skutt ned en ballistisk missil mens houthiene krevde 51 milliarder dollar for en våpenhvile, samtidig som saudiske styrker også avskjærte houthi-missiler rettet mot Medina. Konflikten forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

An Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo has killed more than 5,300 people, prompting WHO warnings of a continent-wide spread, and a UK doctor contracted Ebola while fighting the outbreak. The Allied Democratic Forces returned to Lubero, spreading fear amid the Ebola crisis, and rescued 29 hostiles from ADF extremists. The conflict caused 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Et ebolautbrudd i Øst-DR Kongo har drept mer enn 5 300 personer, noe som har fått WHO til å advare om en kontinent-omfattende spredning, og en britisk lege ble smittet med ebola mens han bekjempet utbruddet. Allied Democratic Forces vendte tilbake til Lubero, spredte frykt midt i ebolakrisen, og reddet 29 fiender fra ADF-ekstremister. Konflikten forårsaket 1 158 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.
